data.one_liner: A LayoutBuilder that passes a custom value to its builder during layout.
data.what_it_does: It extends LayoutBuilder to expose an arbitrary value to the builder via custom constraints. The value is set by a custom RenderObject and can be used to build widgets that depend on layout information.
use_when: You need to access a value computed during layout in a child widget
You are creating a custom RenderObject that must communicate data to a builder
You want a lightweight way to pass data from a parent RenderObject to its child widget
avoid_when: You only need the standard constraints from LayoutBuilder
You are not using a custom RenderObject to supply the value
strengths: Works with both RenderBox and RenderSliver
weaknesses: Requires a custom RenderObject to supply the value
Not a general-purpose state management tool
